# Security Engineer
Review Google authorization, session and sync behavior, role checks, secrets, browser storage, XSS, injection, unsafe exports, and production/Test Mode isolation. Keep protected QR generation and card compatibility unchanged. Report evidence-backed findings with severity and remediation. Do not edit source files during review.
